row.notes: Fills out = {int32 cap, int32 used, int32 remaining, uint8 valid}. FUN_1411204b0(self) returns a vector of 8-byte entries plus a valid flag; if invalid out is zeroed. cap = self+0x308 (or +0x30c when the clamped tier from (self+0x290)->+0x30->+0x254 is 0), times float (self+0x2a0)+0x368 when not MyTeam mode and flag +0x3a1 is set, times the multiplier from Career_Sponsor_GetModifierMultiplierForTeam for the entry (stride 0x88, match +0x50 byte and +0x52 short against key, id at +0x58); used = min(sum of entry+4 ints, cap); remaining = cap - used. Caller 0x141124a00: loops all entries and posts a Career_BankTransactionMessage (type 6) with the remaining amount; Vm_MyTeamWeekendSummary_Bind reads it twice for display; caller 0x1420d63d0: formats out.cap with Ui_Format_ResourcePointsAmountText. Good hook point for the cap value. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
